title: Redesign internal/herd/dashboard to stop depending on the deleted execution state, or move it to ticfac
body: internal/herd/dashboard (4,414 lines) still imports the full internal/herd/client, internal/herd/herdtest, and internal/herd/state — none of which this tick could shrink or delete, because dashboard genuinely needs live herdr event subscription and reads state.Manifest, which nothing writes anymore now that tk herd spawn is deleted. The tick nkf text says dashboard STAYS as a ticfac consumer reading run state through a supported interface, but contracts/ticfac-run-state.json says ticks_reads_ticfac is false, and SPEC.md 2.3 assigns 'execution dashboards' to ticfac outright. These need reconciling before dashboard/state/client/herdtest can be trimmed to satisfy nkf's acceptance criteria (internal/herd contains only relay and dashboard plus what they need).
